name: Aladdin
kurzbeschreibung: Aladdin in Tirol Magic, adventure, and a touch of the exotic – welcome to Tirol, where the spirit of Aladdin comes to life!
beschreibung: The **Aladdin** in **Kufstein** is the perfect spot for a quick yet delicious pick-me-up. With a varied selection of hot and cold snacks, savory bites, and sweet treats, there’s something for everyone. Every dish is prepared with care and fresh ingredients—whether it’s hearty sausage specialties, crispy schnitzel in a roll, or vegetarian options. The friendly staff ensures fast service and a smile on every guest’s face. Ideal for a break while exploring the region, a quick lunch, or a snack on the go, **Aladdin** delivers solid quality at fair prices in **Kufstein**.
